common_gaps: The Qt library has not compiled or run in the authoring environment.
No component has passed browser-to-native visual, animation or platform accessibility review.
Only New York v4 and the neutral theme have draft implementations.
Out-of-gamut OKLCH colours are channel-clipped rather than CSS gamut-mapped.
Colour animation uses premultiplied sRGB rather than a verified CSS interpolation space.
Inherited Qt operations follow Qt contracts unless an override is documented.
The implemented transitions cover selected state changes, not every CSS transition-all property.

implemented_scope: Space and Enter activation, disabled and invalid state, hover transitions.
differences: CSS shadows are absent.
Native font metrics and icon rendering differ.
React asChild composition has no direct C++ equivalent.

implemented_scope: Header, description, action, content and footer layouts.
Shared card colours, borders and spacing.
differences: CSS shadow-sm is absent.
Slots are layout accessors rather than eight separate upstream slot classes.
CSS container queries and arbitrary class overrides are not implemented.

implemented_scope: QLineEdit text editing, password mode, placeholder and validation description.
differences: Colour and shadow transitions are absent.
HTML file, date and numeric input types are not implemented.
Disabled placeholder and selection opacity need reference checks.

implemented_scope: Default and small tracks, keyboard and pointer activation.
Animated thumb, right-to-left layout and reduced motion.
differences: Qt exposes inherited checkbox accessibility semantics, not a reviewed switch role.
CSS shadows are absent.
Radix package implementation and platform assistive technology parity remain unreviewed.
Link activation, icons, asChild composition, invalid and focus states are not implemented.

implemented_scope: Native progress state, animated determinate fill and empty indeterminate track.
differences: Qt values are integers; upstream accepts numbers.
Range and accessibility differences need Radix and native checks.
Only horizontal painting is supported. Inherited Qt text and vertical-orientation options are not implemented.

implemented_scope: Qt buddy association, click-to-focus, click-to-toggle and disabled buddy tracking.
differences: Grouped disabled opacity, selection prevention and mnemonic behaviour need reference checks.

implemented_scope: Decorative horizontal and vertical one-logical-pixel lines.
differences: Non-decorative accessible separator semantics are not implemented.

implemented_scope: Native checked, unchecked and mixed states.
Pointer, keyboard, disabled, invalid and focus handling.
differences: The mixed-state dash is a deliberate native difference, not an upstream-identical indicator.
The check mark is drawn locally, not the upstream Lucide SVG.
CSS shadows and transition-shadow are absent.

implemented_scope: Two-second opacity pulse with shared accent colour and radius.
Animation stops while hidden or when reduced motion is selected.
differences: Browser-to-Qt timing and pixel comparisons have not run.
